_comment: What is live in production. database: from supabase/tests/appatlas_snapshot.sql. edge_functions: from Dashboard -> Edge Functions or `supabase functions list` (SQL cannot see them).

team_roles.name: Super admin
team_roles.description: The owner. Can do everything and grant access.

team_roles.name: City manager
team_roles.description: Runs one city: orders, customers, stock, prices, reports.

team_roles.name: Warehouse manager
team_roles.description: Runs one warehouse: receiving, counts, wastage, packing.

team_roles.name: Procurement buyer
team_roles.description: Buys from suppliers and mandis; records receipts and costs.

team_roles.name: Sales / key accounts
team_roles.description: Signs up and approves customers; manages their terms.

team_roles.name: Support agent
team_roles.description: Answers customers; edits and cancels orders.

team_roles.name: Logistics partner
team_roles.description: A third-party delivery partner: sees fulfilment for its city only.

team_roles.name: Picker / packer
team_roles.description: Picks and packs orders in the warehouse.
